retained_persistent_consumers: All future cache/index consumers in G1 must retain persistent outputs; template list alone does not enumerate all invocations
rewrite: Candidate composite boundary preserving original semantic operations and value versions; no reassociation or removal proved
precision_conditions: Preserve all existing casts, rounding, reduction order and mutable state unless equivalence is independently established

variants.transformation: One main-projection contraction reads three auxiliary sources through the ordered row plan directly, avoiding private row-selected copies/concat where unobserved.
variants.argument: [S_I A0 | S_I A1 | S_I A2] = S_I [A0|A1|A2], including repeated valid indices and original order. Preserve a single15360D contraction and BF16 output boundary.
variants.limits: Not three separately rounded BF16 GEMMs plus adds. Bounds/negative-index behavior, readonly generations and all raw auxiliary observers remain conditions.

variants.transformation: Let full-row norm read rank-major gather shards directly, or have collective layout publication supply the norm layout; avoid a private transpose where legal.
variants.argument: Read value[p,m,c] as feature p*640+c of row m. Reduce all8 shards for the5120D norm and apply matching gamma/eps before publishing BF16 output.
variants.limits: For M>1 [8,M,640] is not a contiguous [M,5120] view. Full row readiness/global reduction is still required; local640 norms are invalid.

variants.transformation: Publish final norm prefix directly into the existing persistent context bank, or redesign the explicit precompute input ABI to consume the norm output.
variants.argument: For original context count Nc, an equivalent normal write of norm_output[:Nc] to the same bank prefix can replace a separate prefix copy if no intermediate observer or alias sees the temporary.
variants.limits: Keep original source Nc, unchanged tail, captured address/stride, readiness, all bank consumers and metadata274. Only24 TensorMove are positively counted here; no claim88 copy kernels removed.

variants.transformation: Replicate complete main weight; project each rank physical auxiliary rows to full5120 features, normalize locally, then exchange rows and apply the original ordered selector.
variants.argument: Projection and full-feature RMSNorm are row-local. With complete W and same per-row arithmetic, S_I f(A)=f(S_I A).
variants.limits: A640-output shard cannot do this alone. Complete weight150MiB/rank versus18.75MiB shard, extra131.25MiB logical weight. Computing N physical rows before an M-row selector costs N/M projection work; padding/extra rows/earlier overlap and quantization metadata matter.

variants.transformation: Retain640-feature partitions and use a global norm-statistic reduction plus partition-aware downstream KV consumers.
variants.argument: For already rounded BF16 projection y, s=sum_p sum_c float(y_p,c)^2 determines full-row denominator; local gamma can be applied after global s. KV partial outputs then need their own global sum/consumer protocol.
variants.limits: FP32 reduction/native RMS order and BF16 outputs must be preserved or numerically validated. Gathering full context afterward adds a collective without reducing activation volume; three FP32 KV AllReduces may exceed the current BF16 feature AllGather.
